caseNameFull: Dombrowski v. Pfister, Chairman, Joint Legislative Committee on Un-American Activities of the Louisiana Legislature
attorneys: Ernest Goodman and David Rein on the motion.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Louisiana. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 377 U. S. 976.) The motion of National Lawyers Guild for leave to file a brief, as amicus curiae, is granted.

Mr. Justice Black took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
